title: Prepare Architektur und Technologie for End-to-End Deployment
description: Resume the existing Architektur und Technologie readiness objective against current October 19 source. The old 26/10/14/GENERALIZE-QUIZ-INTO-COURSE directory contains only generated files and repo MCP ticket_reopen confirms its ticket metadata is absent. Repair current course command/router/E2E/deployment integration regressions, preserve owned compiler authority and runtime-only packaging, register all executable commands in launch.json following current order/group/naming, and verify actual current-source end-to-end release readiness without changing Git/worktrees/AGENTS or losing concurrent work.
